articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Jacobs has declared a quarterly cash dividend payable to shareholders in the amount of $0.36 per share of Jacobs common stock.
articles.title: Jacobs declares quarterly dividend

articles.summary: A Jacobs and AECOM joint venture has been appointed to Iarnród Éireann’s (Irish Rail’s) new Multi-Disciplinary Consultancy Framework, establishing a long-term relationship to support the development and delivery of rail infrastructure projects across Ireland.
articles.title: Jacobs and AECOM joint venture appointed to Iarnród Éireann’s (Irish Rail’s) new consultancy framework

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected by Sanofi as the Engineering, Procurement and Construction Management partner for a new insulin manufacturing facility in Frankfurt, Germany.
articles.title: Jacobs selected by Sanofi to deliver new insulin manufacturing facility in Germany

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected as a key supply partner for the VolkerFitzpatrick and VolkerStevin joint venture, which has secured a place on Anglian Water’s Major Projects Framework for Asset Management Periods 8 and 9.
articles.title: Jacobs selected as key supply partner for Anglian Water’s Major Projects Framework

articles.summary: This summer, a team of Jacobs volunteers traveled to Karambo, Rwanda, to work with Fika and the local community on the construction of a suspended pedestrian bridge that will improve access to schools, healthcare, markets and essential services for thousands of residents.
articles.title: Connecting communities through collaboration in Rwanda

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected by the Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority for a key role in major revitalization projects at Washington Dulles International Airport and Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport through a multi-year program that will modernize and expand two of America’s most iconic aviation gateways.
articles.title: Jacobs selected for multi-year Washington DC area airport modernization program

articles.summary: Jacobs has been appointed by Cochin International Airport Limited to develop a comprehensive 25-year master plan for Cochin International Airport in Kochi, Kerala, India.
articles.title: Jacobs to develop 25-year master plan for Cochin International Airport in India

articles.summary: Jacobs has been reappointed by Transport Infrastructure Ireland to provide technical advisory services for the operation and management of Ireland’s major road tunnels and its Motorway Operations Control Centre.
articles.title: Jacobs reappointed to support Ireland’s road tunnels

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected by ACCIONA to provide multidisciplinary design and project delivery services for the Warkworth to Te Hana Ara Tūhono section of New Zealand's Northland Corridor highway program.
articles.title: Jacobs selected for major New Zealand highway project

articles.summary: Jacobs, together with JBA Consulting, is developing the methodology to inform the first generation of the New Zealand Flood Map to improve resilience and long-term adaptation. See how integrated data and digital solutions are shaping safer communities and future-ready infrastructure.
articles.title: Supporting the development of the New Zealand Flood Map

articles.summary: Jacobs today announced the appointment of Richard “Ric” Phillips to its Board of Directors, effective December 1, 2026.
articles.title: Jacobs appoints Richard “Ric” Phillips to Board of Directors
